uncertainties.question: How should the repeated small unslashed 32nd notes be realized in Variation IV?
uncertainties.provisional_treatment: Keep printed F4 grace at P074–P078 and Eb4/D4 graces at P079 as zero-metrical-duration 32nds with no steal-time percentage.
uncertainties.reason_for_uncertainty: Three small flags and unslashed stems establish notation but do not specify unique performance timing. Reader grace types disagree; enlarged print supports 32nds.

reader_consultation: Compared all released violin P074–P079 claims: SmartScore supports dotted-half and dotted-eighth rhythm but omits graces; PlayScore detects some graces with inconsistent types and replaces dots with rests; Audiveris incomplete. Direct enlarged print controls repeated motif at each location. Candidate P074/P077 cello bears octave/rhythm errors not supported by print.
